schemes.title: Ladakh e-SEVA — Certificates and Citizen Services
schemes.department: Administration of the Union Territory of Ladakh
schemes.brief: Ladakh's own e-services portal, set up after the union territory was formed. Income, category, character and other certificates and departmental services are applied for here instead of travelling to Leh or Kargil, which in winter can mean waiting for a road to open.
schemes.benefit: Income, category and other certificates applied for without travelling to the district headquarters
eligibility: Resident of Ladakh, applying in the district — Leh or Kargil — where the family lives
A Scheduled Tribe certificate is issued for the tribes notified for Ladakh
A residence certificate needs proof the family has lived in the territory for the qualifying period
An income certificate is valid for one year
documents: Aadhaar card of the applicant
Ration card of the family
Father's Scheduled Tribe certificate, for a tribe certificate
School certificate or birth certificate for date of birth
Certificate from the Numberdar or the village head
Income proof — salary certificate or an affidavit
Passport-size photograph

demoFields.label: Service wanted
demoFields.hint: Income, Scheduled Tribe, residence, character or a departmental service. Each has its own form and proof.

demoFields.label: Applicant Name (as on Aadhaar)
demoFields.hint: Letter for letter as on Aadhaar. The certificate prints from this entry.

demoFields.label: Father's / Husband's Name
demoFields.hint: Used to identify the family; essential for a tribe certificate.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: Twelve digits. Identity is confirmed on this and the OTP goes to the linked mobile.

demoFields.label: District / Block / Village
demoFields.hint: Where the family lives. The Tehsildar or the Sub-Divisional Magistrate of this area signs.

demoFields.label: Numberdar or village head certificate
demoFields.value: Goba, Chuchot Shamma — signed and stamped
demoFields.hint: Most Ladakh certificates need it. Get it before you apply, since the village head may be hard to reach later.

demoFields.label: Annual Family Income (Rs.)
demoFields.hint: For an income certificate, the household's total for the year including farming and any tourism season work.

demoFields.label: Purpose
demoFields.hint: Recorded for the file. It does not restrict where the certificate is used.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number
demoFields.hint: The application number and the ready message come here by SMS.

demoSteps: Get the Numberdar's or village head's certificate first. Most Ladakh certificates rest on it.
Register on eseva.ladakh.gov.in with your mobile and confirm the OTP, or use a Common Service Centre.
Choose the certificate and fill the form from your Aadhaar and the ration card.
Upload the documents, pay any fee, and note the application number.
The tehsil staff verify the family, then the Tehsildar or the Sub-Divisional Magistrate signs.
Download the certificate from the same login. In winter, apply well before you need it — verification in the outlying blocks can be slow when roads are closed.
schemes.helpline: Your Tehsildar's office, or the Deputy Commissioner's office at Leh or Kargil

schemes.title: Ladakh Domicile Certificate
schemes.department: Revenue Department, Union Territory of Ladakh
schemes.brief: The domicile certificate of Ladakh, which decides who can hold a state government post and buy land in the territory. It has its own portal, separate from the general e-services, and its own conditions on years of residence, study or government service.
schemes.benefit: Ladakh domicile certificate, required for territory government posts and land
eligibility: Resident of Ladakh for the qualifying period, or a child of a government servant who served there for the required years
A person who studied in Ladakh for the qualifying years and sat Class 10 or Class 12 there also qualifies
Children of a Ladakh domicile holder qualify through the parent
One certificate per person; it does not expire
documents: Aadhaar card of the applicant
Parent's domicile certificate or Permanent Resident Certificate, where claiming through a parent
School certificates showing the years studied in Ladakh
Ration card of the family
Revenue record or rent agreement showing residence
Government service certificate of the parent, where claiming on that ground
Passport-size photograph

demoFields.label: Ground of the domicile claim
demoFields.value: Resident of Ladakh for fifteen years
demoFields.hint: Residence for the qualifying period, study and examination in Ladakh, a parent's domicile, or a parent's government service. Say which one and attach its proof — this is what the whole application turns on.

demoFields.label: Applicant Name (as on Aadhaar)
demoFields.hint: Letter for letter as on Aadhaar. The certificate prints from this entry.

demoFields.label: Father's / Mother's Name
demoFields.hint: Where you are claiming through a parent, their name must match their own domicile or service certificate.

demoFields.label: Date of Birth
demoFields.hint: As on the Class 10 certificate or the birth certificate you attach.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: Twelve digits, of the applicant.

demoFields.label: District / Tehsil / Village
demoFields.hint: Where the family lives. The Tehsildar of this tehsil issues the certificate.

demoFields.label: Years and place of residence or study
demoFields.value: Resident at Chuchot Shamma since 2004; Class 10 from Government High School, Chuchot, 2018
demoFields.hint: Be exact with the years and the school. This is the part the verifying officer actually checks.

demoFields.label: Parent's certificate number, where claiming through a parent
demoFields.value: Not applicable — claiming on own residence
demoFields.hint: Fill it only if the claim runs through a parent's domicile or government service, and attach that certificate.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number
demoFields.hint: The application number and the ready message come here by SMS.

demoSteps: Decide which ground you are claiming under and gather the proof for that ground before you start. Applying on the wrong ground is why most files come back.
Register on the domicile portal with your Aadhaar and mobile and confirm the OTP.
Fill the form, stating the years and the place of residence or study exactly, and upload the school certificates, the revenue record and the parent's certificate where relevant.
Submit and note the application number.
The patwari and the tehsil staff verify the claim on the ground. Be available at the address, since this verification is done in person.
The Tehsildar issues the certificate and it is downloaded from the portal.
Keep it safely. It does not expire, and territory government recruitment and land purchase both turn on it.
schemes.helpline: Your Tehsildar's office, or the Deputy Commissioner's office at Leh or Kargil

schemes.title: Puducherry e-District — Certificates and Services
schemes.brief: Puducherry's e-District portal covers the certificates and services of the union territory's four regions — Puducherry, Karaikal, Mahe and Yanam. Income, community, nativity and residence certificates are applied for and downloaded here.
schemes.benefit: Income, community, nativity and residence certificates applied for online
eligibility: Resident of Puducherry, Karaikal, Mahe or Yanam
A nativity certificate needs proof the family has lived in the territory for the qualifying period
A community certificate needs the community to be on the Puducherry SC, ST, BC or MBC list
An income certificate is valid for one year
documents: Aadhaar card of the applicant
Ration card of the family
Electricity bill or house tax receipt for the address
Father's community certificate, for a community certificate
School transfer certificate for date of birth and nativity
Income proof — salary certificate or an affidavit
Passport-size photograph

demoFields.label: Certificate applied for
demoFields.hint: Income, community, nativity, residence, birth or death. Each has its own form and proof.

demoFields.label: Region
demoFields.hint: Puducherry, Karaikal, Mahe or Yanam. The taluk office of that region handles the file.

demoFields.label: Applicant Name (as on Aadhaar)
demoFields.hint: Letter for letter as on Aadhaar. The certificate prints from this entry.

demoFields.label: Father's / Husband's Name
demoFields.hint: For a community certificate this decides the case — community is traced through the father's family record.

demoFields.label: Community claimed
demoFields.hint: Pick from the Puducherry list. SC, ST, BC and MBC are separate lists with separate benefits.

demoFields.label: Aadhaar Number
demoFields.hint: Twelve digits. Identity is confirmed on this and the OTP goes to the linked mobile.

demoFields.label: Taluk / Commune or Municipality / Street
demoFields.hint: Where the family lives. The Tahsildar of this taluk signs the certificate.

demoFields.label: Annual Family Income (Rs.)
demoFields.hint: For an income certificate, the household's total for the year from every source.

demoFields.label: Mobile Number
demoFields.hint: The application number and the ready message come here by SMS.

demoSteps: Register on edistrict.py.gov.in with your mobile and confirm the OTP, or use a Common Service Centre in your region.
Choose the certificate, pick your region, and fill the form from your Aadhaar and ration card.
Upload the documents. For a community certificate, the father's certificate is the paper that matters most.
Submit, pay the fee, and note the application number.
The Village Administrative Officer verifies the family, then the Tahsildar signs the certificate.
Download it from the same login and check the community name and your father's name at once.
schemes.helpline: Your taluk Tahsildar's office, or the Collectorate of your region
